n,m = map(int,input().split())
l1 = list(map(int,input().split()))
def fun(n,m,l1):
    l2 = dict((l,l1.count(l)) for l in set(l1))
    day = 1
    def poss(day):
        q = 0
        for v in l2.values():
            q += v // day
        return q >= n
    while poss(day):
        day += 1
    return day - 1
print(fun(n,m,l1))
